profile.headline: Senior SDET @ Crowdstrike
profile.summary:
Seasoned QA leader with 10+ years of experience driving quality strategies, fostering testing cultures, and solving complex, cross-functional challenges. I specialize in designing scalable quality processes, enhancing product reliability, and mentoring teams to elevate quality ownership.

Key achievements include leading an enterprise-wide bug tracking migration, optimizing product quality metrics and monitoring, and driving measurable improvements in incident prevention. I thrive in collaborative environments, aligning teams on clear goals to deliver high-impact results. Passionate about building systems that empower teams to continuously own and improve quality.

Let’s connect if you're looking for a leader who blends technical expertise with a strategic mindset to drive exceptional product quality.

positions.title: QE Lead
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
* Led the identification of critical bugs in App and Sales Ads, Dynamic Ads, and Audience Network by training outsourcing teams and overseeing testing for high-risk projects, including an Ads Manager infrastructure migration
* Improved operational efficiency and revenue protection by reducing Dynamic Ads on-call auditing overhead by 1 business day per week and enhancing incident revenue loss monitoring through a risk-focused code auditing process
* Transitioned from Meta to pursue a role with greater hands-on technical ownership and deeper engagement in quality engineering.
positions.insights: Skills: Quality Assurance Strategy · Process Improvement and Optimization

positions.title: Staff Quality Engineer
positions.description:
* Joined Descript to take on a more hands-on technical role, driving quality strategy for the recorder and web-first experience, leading to improved reliability and incident prevention.
* Refined product QE interview loop, enhancing the quality of QE talent acquisition and supporting calibration sessions
* Coordinated release check-ins and go/no-go decisions for "Storyboard," a company-wide initiative to enhance video editing capabilities
* Improved incident health visibility by reporting common trends and automated detection rate to enable proactive incident prevention and detection initiatives
positions.insights: Skills: Quality Assurance Strategy · Project Management and Sprint Planning · Incident Management · Product Quality Metrics · Process Improvement and Optimization

positions.title: Staff QA Technical Lead
positions.description:
* Drove the technical migration of the company’s bug tracking system from Maniphest to Jira, improving team alignment and project visibility
* Guided 2 senior QAEs to establish a group-wide quality risks and mitigation process, which improved incident tracking and prevention
* Guided a senior QAE to plan and run execution of the Plus+ initiative to help prevent incidents at launch
* Optimized execution management through sprint planning and quality plan reviews, streamlining workflows and increasing testing efficiency.

positions.title: QA Technical Lead
positions.description:
* Spearheaded the quality strategy and execution of the Dropbox desktop foreground revamp across multiple QAEs and cross-functional teams to help prevent incidents at launch
* Designed and implemented a comprehensive company-wide strategy for measuring product quality metrics, increasing visibility into product health and enabling data-driven decision-making across teams
* Mentored 2 QAEs to improve their quality approach on their feature areas

positions.title: QA Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Managed a team of 8 direct reports, providing structured feedback on performance, career growth, and team collaboration to improve individual and group outcomes
- Led QA team direction by redesigning sprint planning, OKR processes, staffing strategies, and a QA career framework, increasing team alignment and efficiency
- Optimized the QA hiring process, enhancing phone screening methods, refining QA EM interview questions, and conducting interviews to streamline hiring.
- Improved organizational quality processes by assessing bug management, release breakages, and other workflows, driving measurable improvements in process efficiency.
- Oversaw product component ownership processes, ensuring clear accountability and direction for company-wide product teams.

positions.title: QA Engineer / Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Mentored over 7 QA engineers to enhance their feature quality approach and effectively address common quality challenges.
- Led testing for the sharing and files rewrite, collaborating with multiple teams to ensure successful delivery of critical features.
- Enhanced quality health by establishing a retrospective process for critical bugs, developing a bug ownership model, maintaining engineering on-call processes, and running process health evaluations.
- Designed sprint planning processes to prioritize high-impact projects, optimizing team focus and resource allocation.
- Collaborated with customer experience teams to resolve top user complaints, improving customer satisfaction and reducing issue recurrence.

positions.title: QA Engineer / Senior QA Engineer
positions.description:
- Directed Firefox OS releases by organizing outsourced test runs, conducting triage sessions to prioritize blocking issues, and performing feature testing, ensuring high-quality product delivery
- Mentored an intern to strengthen their expertise in feature testing and smoke test dashboard development
- Developed JavaScript automated tests for getUserMedia and managed a WebAPI test case data repository, preventing regressions and improving test coverage for critical APIs
positions.insights: Skills: Release Management · Triage and Issue Prioritization · Test Automation · Test Case Management · Leadership and Mentorship
